t: What Does The Name Dilayla Mean?
s: In Arabic and Persian traditions, Leila/Leilah/Lejla has long literary pedigree-most famously in the romance of Layla and Majnun-while in Hebrew contexts, Laila is also used, sometimes associated with “night” and angelic night symbolism. In Turkish, Dila means “heart” or “tongue/speech,” and Layla/ Leyla is common; Dilayla can be read by Turkish speakers as a blended coinage that evokes both “heart” (dil) and “night” (Leyla), even if not historically formed that way.
